newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta exchange temporarily freezes five firms.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta exchange temporarily freezes five firms.

text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange supervisory agency Bapepam has temporarily frozen the operational licences of five local brokerage firms, the exchange said in a statement received on Tuesday.
It said the five companies had stopped operations for more than one year and also hired directors and employees who had not obtained the necessary licences from Bapepam.
"Directors or employees of those companies did not obtain licences from Bapepam as required by the agency," it said.
The companies are PT Artha Adyanugraha, PT Creative Securities, PT Danagajah Sakti, PT Pancasumber Dhanamandiri and PT Sarana Invesindo.
The agency said they had failed to fulfill their obligations to submit activity reports to Bapepam.
"If within 90 days those companies do not improve their conditions, Bapepam will take further action," the agency said, without elaborating.
